description:
Program Overview

The Max Planck Internship 2027 is a , fully funded research internship opportunity offered by the Max Planck Society, one of Germany's foremost research organizations. This program provides international students with the chance to conduct research at various Max Planck Institutes across Germany.

The internship is specifically designed for bachelor's, master's, and PhD students from around the world who are interested in gaining hands-on research experience in a academic environment. The program focuses on various disciplines, with particular emphasis on computer science, software systems, security, and privacy.

Funding Details & Benefits

  • Monthly stipend: €1,300 per month for living expenses.
  • Travel allowance: Round-trip economy class airfare to/from Germany.
  • Accommodation: Free housing provided for the entire internship duration.
  • Visa fees: Full coverage and reimbursement.
  • Health insurance: Coverage for medical emergencies during internship.
  • Research Facilities: Access to state-of-the-art laboratories and research infrastructure.
  • Mentorship: Guidance from leading researchers and scientists in the field.
  • Networking Opportunities: Interaction with international researchers and peers.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Currently enrolled as a bachelor's, master's, or PhD student at a recognized university.
  • Studying in a relevant field, particularly computer science, software systems, security, privacy, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrate strong academic performance and research potential.
  • Good command of English (German is not always required but beneficial).
  • Previous research experience is advantageous but not always mandatory.
  • Open to international students from all countries.

Eligible Fields of Study

  • Computer Science (primary focus)
  • Software Systems Engineering
  • Cybersecurity and Privacy
  • Data Science and Machine Learning
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Computational Biology
  • Physics (for some institutes)
  • Other interdisciplinary fields

Participating Institutes (Examples)

  • Max Planck Institute for Informatics (Saarbrücken)
  • Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (Bochum)
  • Max Planck Institute for Software Systems (Kaiserslautern)
  • Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems (Stuttgart/Tübingen)
  • Max Planck Institute of Molecular Cell Biology and Genetics (Dresden)

Application Process

  1. Research available institutes and their research focus.
  2. Prepare application documents: CV, letter of motivation, academic transcripts, letter of recommendation, language proficiency proof, passport copy, photo.
  3. Complete online application through the official portal.
  4. Submit application by 1 November 2026.
  5. Wait for selection results (typically January-February 2027).
  6. Accept offer and prepare for Germany.

Timeline & Deadlines

MilestoneDate
Application opensAugust-September 2026
Application deadline1 November 2026
Review periodNovember-December 2026
InterviewsDecember 2026-January 2027
NotificationJanuary-February 2027
Internship duration12-14 weeks (typically May-June 2027 start)

Official Application Link

https://apply.cis.mpg.de/register/internship

Official Resources

  • Max Planck Society: https://www.mpg.de
  • MPI for Informatics: https://www.mpi-inf.mpg.de
  • MPI for Security and Privacy: https://www.mpi-sp.org

Contact

  • MPI for Informatics: internships@mpi-inf.mpg.de
  • Individual institutes: Check their websites for contact details

Important Notes

  • The application deadline for the 2027 summer internship is 1 November 2026.
  • German language proficiency is not typically required as English is the working language.
  • Each Max Planck Institute may have specific eligibility requirements and research focus areas.
